articles.title: Hyundai Bayon unveiled in India: AI assistant, dual 12.3 inch screens and more
articles.content: Business News Auto Hyundai Bayon unveiled in India: AI assistant, dual 12.3-inch screens and more Hyundai Bayon unveiled in India: AI assistant, dual 12.3-inch screens and more Customers can book the SUV through Hyundai's official website, hyundai.co.in, or at an authorised Hyundai dealership Advertisement Share: The Bayon will feature Hyundai Motor India's first generative AI voice assistant, an NVIDIA-powered Connected Car Navigation Cockpit Business Today Desk Oct 12, 2026, Updated Oct 12, 2026 8:30 PM IST Subscribe to Notifications Hyundai Motor India unveiled the India-spec Hyundai Bayon on Monday, with the SUV set to launch on October 26. The new SUV features a generative AI voice assistant, dual 12.3-inch displays, more than 70 connected-car features, and over-the-air software updates. The carmaker said bookings are open online and at authorised Hyundai dealerships for Rs 11,000, and deliveries are scheduled to begin during the festive season. Advertisement Read More Related Articles Tata Motors PV, Ather Energy, Hyundai, M&M: Share price targets ahead of Q2 results The Bayon will feature Hyundai Motor India's first generative AI voice assistant, an NVIDIA-powered Connected Car Navigation Cockpit (ccNC), dual 12.3-inch curved panoramic displays and more than 70 Hyundai Bluelink connected features. The company is positioning the Bayon as an Intelligent Utility Vehicle, built around the philosophy of "Intelligence That Moves". Its technology package focuses on voice-based assistance, navigation, remote vehicle controls, and a digital cockpit designed to simplify everyday driving. Customers can book the SUV through Hyundai's official website, hyundai.co.in, or at an authorised Hyundai dealership. One of the key features of the Bayon is Hyundai Motor India's first-ever generative AI voice assistant. The system combines Intelligence by Perplexity with voice AI powered by SoundHound AI to enable more natural conversations between drivers and the vehicle. Advertisement Unlike conventional voice assistants that rely mainly on predefined commands, the system is designed to understand conversational requests and provide relevant responses. Drivers can ask the assistant to prepare a road-trip itinerary, provide real-time weather information, suggest hotels at their destination or recommend restaurants based on their journey. It can also suggest nearby shopping destinations and provide information on sports coverage, scores and related insights. The SUV also supports more than 500 embedded voice commands in English, Hindi, Hinglish, Tamil, Bengali and Telugu. These commands allow drivers to access several frequently used vehicle functions without an internet connection. Hyundai Motor India managing director and CEO Tarun Garg said the Bayon brings artificial intelligence, connectivity and software-driven innovation together to create a more intuitive and personalised driving experience. Advertisement “With Hyundai BAYON, we are introducing an Intelligent Utility Vehicle that places technology and convenience at the heart of the customer experience," Garg said. He added that the generative AI voice assistant, connected cockpit, over-the-air updates and Bluelink features represent the next generation of intelligent mobility for Indian customers. Dual 12.3-inch displays and NVIDIA-powered cockpit The Hyundai Bayon will feature two 12.3-inch curved panoramic displays, bringing together driving information, navigation, entertainment and connected functions in a unified digital cockpit. articles.title: Hyundai Bayon India Launch on October 26, Bookings Open - MotorBeam
articles.content: Hyundai Motor India has confirmed that the India-spec Bayon will be launched on October 26, 2026. Bookings for the SUV are now open at Hyundai dealerships and through the company’s website for Rs. 11,000, with deliveries scheduled to begin during the festive season. Detailed delivery timelines will be announced at launch. The Bayon will be positioned around technology and connected features, with Hyundai describing it as an Intelligent Utility Vehicle. Its equipment package includes a generative AI voice assistant, a connected-car navigation cockpit, over-the-air updates, dual curved displays and Hyundai Bluelink connectivity. Hyundai Bayon gets generative AI voice assistant One of the Bayon’s key features is Hyundai Motor India’s first generative AI voice assistant. The system combines Intelligence by Perplexity with voice AI technology from SoundHound AI. Unlike conventional systems that are largely dependent on fixed commands, Hyundai says the assistant is designed to understand conversational requests and provide relevant responses. It can be used for tasks such as preparing a road-trip itinerary, checking real-time weather information, finding hotels and restaurants, suggesting nearby shopping destinations and providing sports-related information, including scores and coverage. Hyundai Bayon gets NVIDIA-accelerated ccNC system The Bayon will feature Hyundai’s Connected Car Navigation Cockpit (ccNC), which is accelerated by NVIDIA. The system brings together connected services, navigation and vehicle controls through a unified interface. Features include online navigation, a personalised quick-control panel, split-screen functionality and smartphone-style quick controls. The system is designed to provide access to frequently used functions through the central interface. Up to 19 controllers support OTA updates Hyundai has equipped the Bayon with up to 19 controllers capable of receiving Vehicle Controller Over-the-Air (C-OTA) updates. This allows software enhancements and certain feature updates to be delivered remotely without requiring a visit to a dealership. According to Hyundai, the system is intended to allow the vehicle’s software and features to evolve after purchase, while also helping with maintenance requirements, safety and security-related updates. Hyundai Bayon gets dual 12.3-inch curved displays The Bayon features two 12.3-inch curved panoramic displays, with one serving as the infotainment screen and the other as the driver’s display. Hyundai says the combined 62.5cm display setup integrates driving information, navigation, entertainment and connected functions. The system also supports individual user profiles and personalised controls. Hyundai Bluelink gets more than 70 connected features The Bayon will come with Hyundai Bluelink, offering more than 70 connected features. These include remote start and stop, connected vehicle information, remote vehicle controls, smartphone and smartwatch connectivity, location and navigation-related services, as well as safety and security functions. The SUV also gets a multi-language user interface covering 10 regional and two international languages. Hyundai says this is intended to make vehicle functions and information more accessible to customers across India. Hyundai Bayon supports more than 500 embedded voice commands The Bayon has more than 500 embedded voice commands that can operate without an internet connection. These commands are available in English, Hindi, Hinglish, Tamil, Bengali and Telugu. This allows users to access several frequently used vehicle functions...

articles.title: Kolkata Hosts 2026 World Sudoku and Puzzle Championships - GKToday
articles.content: Home Kolkata Hosts 2026 World Sudoku and Puzzle Championships Kolkata Hosts 2026 World Sudoku and Puzzle Championships October 12, 2026 Current Affairs Today - Latest Current Affairs - 2026-2027 Kolkata is hosting the 19th World Sudoku Championship and the 33rd World Puzzle Championship from 11 to 18 October 2026. The event is being held at The Westin in Rajarhat and organised by Logic Masters India (LMI), the national representative to the World Puzzle Federation since 2008. Participants from 35 countries are taking part. Championship format The programme includes five days of competitive mind-sport events, with 38 rounds, more than 100 Sudoku puzzles and 250 other puzzles created by LMI. Sudoku is a number-placement puzzle commonly presented as a 9-by-9 grid divided into nine 3-by-3 boxes. In the standard format, each row, column and box must contain the digits 1 to 9 without repetition. Puzzle competitions can include different logic and deduction challenges, with formats set by the event organisers. The 2026 puzzles include themes drawn from the Ramayana and the Mahabharata . India previously hosted the World Puzzle Championship in Goa in 2008 and Bengaluru in 2017. Indian participation and public programme The Indian team comprises Kishore Kumar Sridharan, Nityant Agarwal, Harsh Poddar, Jaipal Reddy Mogiligundla and Kartik Reddy. Mogiligundla and Reddy are a father-and-son pair. The team is sponsored by Rodha and is targeting a top-five finish. In 2022, Prasanna Seshadri won India’s first silver medal at the World Puzzle Championship in Poland, while Agarwal won the under-18 gold at the World Sudoku Championship. A public event called Puzzle Palooza is scheduled for 14 October. It includes a LinkedIn Games tournament, a general quiz hosted by Will Shortz and a puzzle-design masterclass organised by LMI. Shortz is the Crossword Editor of The New York Times, while Thomas Snyder is the Principal Puzzlemaster of LinkedIn Games. Matiks is the title sponsor, Amuse Labs is the technology partner, and The Hindu is a media partner. Important Facts for Exams The 2026 event combines the 19th World Sudoku Championship with the 33rd World Puzzle Championship. Logic Masters India has represented India at the World Puzzle Federation since 2008. India hosted earlier editions of the World Puzzle Championship in Goa in 2008 and Bengaluru in 2017. The 2026 championship venue is The Westin in Rajarhat, Kolkata. The championships run from 11 to 18 October 2026, while the competitive programme spans five days. The Indian team includes five participants, including the father-and-son pair Jaipal Reddy Mogiligundla and Kartik Reddy. articles.title: CERVAVAC: India's First Indigenous HPV Vaccine Receives WHO Prequalification
articles.content: Source: TP Subject: Science and Technology Context: The World Health Organization ( WHO ) has granted prequalification to CERVAVAC , making it the first Indian-made quadrivalent human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine to meet global standards for quality, safety, and efficacy. CERVAVAC About CERVAVAC: India’s First Indigenous HPV Vaccine Receives WHO Prequalification What it is? India’s first indigenously developed, gender-neutral quadrivalent Human Papillomavirus (qHPV) vaccine designed as a preventive oncology vaccine to protect against cervical cancer and HPV-related diseases. Developed by: Manufactured and developed indigenously by the Serum Institute of India (SII), Pune. Targeted HPV Strains: High-Risk Oncogenic Strains (Types 16 and 18): Responsible for over 70% to 80% of all cervical cancer cases globally. Low-Risk Strains (Types 6 and 11): Responsible for causing approximately 90% of anogenital warts (condyloma acuminata). Key Features of CERVAVAC: First Indigenous Prequalified HPV Vaccine : Stands as the first Indian-manufactured quadrivalent HPV vaccine on the WHO List of Prequalified Vaccines, joining an international pool previously dominated by foreign manufacturers. Broad Age & Gender-Neutral Indication: Licensed in India for administration to both girls and boys aged 9 to 26 years , enabling herd immunity and preventing male HPV burdens such as anal cancers and genital warts. Affordable & Scalable Production: Engineered to be substantially more cost-effective than imported counterparts, leveraging SII’s mass-scale manufacturing to address global supply crunches . Flexible Dosing Regimen: Compatible with WHO-recommended schedules, supporting both single-dose or two-dose regimens for the primary target group of adolescents aged 9 to 14 years. Rigorous International Quality Benchmark : Validated through extensive clinical evaluations, batch testing, and manufacturing facility audits to meet the stringent safety and immunogenicity guidelines of the WHO. Significance: Accelerates progress toward the WHO’s 90-70-90 target (vaccinating 90% of girls by age 15 by 2030), directly expanding the affordable vaccine supply for Gavi and UNICEF across low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). Provides an indigenous, WHO-standard HPV vaccine, reducing import dependence and procurement costs while strengthening India’s immunisation programme.

articles.title: Navigating the 2027 Threat Horizon: AI Volatility and Environmental Disruption Reshape ...
articles.content: As geopolitical instability intersects with the rapid maturation of artificial intelligence, security and risk (S&R) leaders face unprecedented pressures . The digital landscape in 2027 will not only be defined by sophisticated cyber threats, but also by the complex governance, financial, operational, and regulatory challenges that accompany AI deployment and environmental volatility . Based on Forrester’s Predictions 2027: Cybersecurity And Risk report, five critical shifts will shape the future of enterprise risk management . 1. AI Negligence Will Trigger Executive Ousters and Board Refreshes In the US, AI accountability is moving away from fragmented regulatory frameworks and directly into civil litigation . In 2027, a high-profile court case involving a major corporation will test the limits of executive liability . The primary issue in court will not center on whether the AI system malfunctioned, but whether leadership exercised informed judgment before delegating high-stakes decisions to black-box models . Evidence of disregarded warnings, missing controls, or misleading assurances will force the departure of a CEO, prompt board restructurings, and ignite calls to modernize fiduciary standards and the SEC Business Judgment Rule . Organizations must ensure AI-driven choices are transparent and defensible under standard duty-of-care expectations . 2. Token Spending Will Top $1.5 Billion as a Core Cybersecurity Budget Category Usage-based pricing models—such as AI tokens and security compute units—are transitioning from experimental line items to central components of S&R planning . Forrester predicts enterprise spending on AI tokens will reach $1.5 billion in 2027, driven primarily by security operations (SecOps) and application security (AppSec) teams . SecOps and AppSec personnel will consume vast token volumes to run automated alert triage, vulnerability scans, code analysis, and patch remediation . Because frontier model providers and security vendors are embedding token usage directly into standard licensing agreements, tokens will become part of the baseline cost of cybersecurity talent . CISOs must pivot from managing AI adoption to strictly monitoring cost versus value . 3. Rapid AI Patching Will Trigger a Global Industry Outage The rate of AI-driven vulnerability discovery is outpacing the software engineering industry’s capacity to manually review and test code fixes . As patch volume skyrockets—sometimes exceeding hundreds or thousands of updates per vendor release—organizations are adopting a high-velocity “find fast and fix things” model . This velocity mismatch will culminate in a massive global outage on par with the catastrophic disruption of July 2024 . Security teams forced to rely on AI to auto-generate code fixes or update software dependencies will inadvertently deploy a flawed fix or regression due to inadequate quality assurance . Resilience strategies will require enterprises to drastically improve their ability to rapidly rollback faulty vendor patches . 4. Natural Disasters Will Drive NIS 2 Compliance Failures for EU Entities While most incident response playbooks focus heavily on cyber threats like malware and compromised credentials, physical disruptions present equal regulatory risk . Europe’s NIS 2 directive mandates 24-hour reporting for significant service disruptions, regardless of whether they are caused by a malicious actor or an “attacker-less” physical event...

articles.title: Vizag ITI cluster becomes first in India to secure PM-SETU approval - Telugu360
articles.content: AM/NS India to invest ₹200 crore to upgrade four Government ITIs in Andhra Pradesh Andhra Pradesh’s Visakhapatnam ITI cluster has become the first in the country to receive approval under the Centre’s PM-SETU scheme, with ArcelorMittal Nippon Steel India committing ₹200 crore to upgrade four Government Industrial Training Institutes. The Andhra Pradesh government, Government of India and AM/NS India signed a shareholders’ agreement for the project on Sunday. A Special Purpose Vehicle will be set up to run the upgraded institutions, with AM/NS India holding a 51% stake and the state and Centre holding 24.5% each. The cluster’s Strategic Investment Plan was the first to be cleared by PM-SETU’s National Steering Committee. The four institutes covered are Government ITI (Old), Kancharapalem, Government ITI (Girls), Industrial Estate in Visakhapatnam, Government ITI at Bobbili and Government ITI at Narsipatnam. Kancharapalem ITI will serve as the hub, sharing facilities and resources with the other three institutes. IT and HRD Minister Nara Lokesh said the partnership was aimed at ensuring industrial growth translates into jobs for Andhra Pradesh youth. “Students at these ITIs will gain practical skills that employers need. By improving training facilities and bringing industry expertise into technical education, we aim to strengthen employability and help them participate in the State’s growth,” he said. AM/NS India, along with its academic and technical partner NAMTECH, will modernise training infrastructure, introduce workplace-relevant equipment and courses, add new trades, expand hands-on learning and strengthen instructor training. AM/NS India Director and Vice-President for HR and Administration Ashutosh Telang said the initiative would combine the company’s manufacturing experience with NAMTECH’s technical education expertise. PM-SETU, with a ₹60,000-crore outlay, seeks to upgrade 1,000 Government ITIs through industry partnerships and strengthen five National Skill Training Institutes. AM/NS India has also signed a separate agreement to upgrade five Government ITIs in Gujarat’s Surat cluster, taking its total commitment across the two states to ₹440 crore for nine ITIs. articles.title: J&K: Chenab, Anji Khad railway bridges boost all-weather rail connectivity to Kashmir
articles.content: J&K: Chenab, Anji Khad railway bridges boost all-weather rail connectivity to Kashmir Updated: 2 hours, 45 min ago Reasi (J&K), October 11 (ANI): The Chenab and Anji Khad railway bridges have strengthened rail connectivity to the Kashmir Valley as part of the Udhampur-Srinagar-Baramulla Rail Link (USBRL) project. The Chenab Rail Bridge, built over the Chenab River in Reasi district, stands 359 metres above the riverbed and is the world's highest railway arch bridge. The Anji Khad Bridge is India's first cable-stayed railway bridge, constructed to navigate the challenging Himalayan terrain. These engineering landmarks form part of the railway network connecting Kashmir with the rest of India, supporting passenger travel and the movement of goods while improving connectivity across the region.
